external_primary_sources.finding: Official CLI exposes --device with examples including cpu; default is cuda:0. It exposes dtype choices and FlashAttention enable/disable, with FlashAttention enabled by default.
Official Qwen3TTSModel.from_pretrained forwards model-loading kwargs and can resolve a CPU device when the loaded model is on CPU.
Official model card lists German among supported languages and describes streaming generation; example configuration is CUDA-oriented and upstream low-latency claims are not CPU-VPS measurements.

Current model.safetensors is approximately 1.81 GB with SHA256 bc3c7e785eb961179c25450d1acff03f839e0002f2f3a5aeb67b5735c0fa2adb at source observation time. Runtime must independently bind exact acquired artifact identity rather than trusting this research note.

preflight_rules: Do not execute the official/example default unchanged on clay-direct-dev: it defaults to cuda:0 while the current target hardware inventory has no NVIDIA/ROCm GPU.
Select CPU explicitly (equivalent to the official CLI --device cpu or exact API device_map CPU binding).
Do not require FlashAttention-2 on CPU; select a CPU-compatible attention path and record it in the receipt.
Choose dtype from actual CPU/PyTorch capability and measure RSS. Do not assume upstream BF16/GPU behavior is valid on this VPS.
Run 0.6B first; do not download/run 1.7B unless the measured 0.6B path leaves sufficient resource headroom and there remains a named information gain.
Separate artifact acquisition from promotion-bearing inference. Record model/revision/file hashes after acquisition; prefer network-off inference thereafter.

Treat dependency/device/dtype/attention incompatibility as INFRA_AUTH_TRANSPORT_QUOTA or EVIDENCE_INVALID until the model itself actually executes; do not create product architecture from an environment setup failure.
Do not use upstream ~97 ms latency as an acceptance target for this CPU-only VPS. Record target-local TTFA/RTF distributions and compare only after exact execution.

streaming cancellation if the executed API is nonstreaming
